geography: Worldwide (Total column of GSK's turnover tables)
indication_area: Prevention of invasive pneumococcal disease and otitis media in infants
moa: 10-valent pneumococcal polysaccharide conjugate vaccine (protein D / tetanus / diphtheria carriers; active immunisation)

approval_evidence.quote: Synflorix S pneumoniae and NTHi prophylaxis n/a Approved Mar 2009 Approved in EU 31st March 2009.

approval_note: Synflorix has no US (FDA) approval; the EU approval of 31 March 2009 is quoted from GSK's Q1 2009 announcement.

launch_evidence.quote: In Europe, we are in the midst of launching two significant new products: Synflorix , a competitive new vaccine that provides increased protection for infants against pneumococcal diseases; and alli , our new weight-loss treatment

series_end_reason: The Q4 2025 announcement (Form 6-K filed 2026-02-04) is the last with a Synflorix row; the Q1 2026 announcement (Form 6-K filed 2026-04-29, a2755c.htm) has no Synflorix turnover row and comments under 'Other Paediatric & Adult Vaccines': 'Sales decreased as a result of competitive pressure for Synflorix primarily in Emerging Markets'.
search_log: Listed GSK plc (CIK 1131399) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (6,852 filings, 6,139 Form 6-K). Located quarterly results announcements with EDGAR full-text search restricted to CIK 1131399 for each of 'Boostrix', 'Rotarix', 'Cervarix', 'Synflorix' and 'Fluarix' (2001-2026); every Form 6-K HTML hit was fetched (118 documents) and every table parsed (bs4).

Quarter figure = Total (first) column of the product row in the turnover-by-product table whose nearest preceding heading reads 'Three months ended <date>' (2005-2016 'Pharmaceutical(s and Vaccines) turnover', from 2017 'Vaccines turnover – three months ended <date>'); six-month, nine-month and year tables are excluded by their heading. Where a period is printed in more than one filing, the earliest-filed announcement (the one reporting it as current) is used; the 2010-09-10 Form 6-K restating 2008-2010 quarters is not cited.
First Synflorix row: Q2 2009 announcement (three months 12, six months 12).
